title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2407 State Route 71, Suite 1, in Spring Lake, New Jersey, as the "James J. Howard Post Office".

la.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 595.

actions.t: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 595.
Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. Reported by Senator Paul without amendment. Without written report.
Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. Ordered to be reported without amendment favorably.
Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H2847)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H2847)
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1431.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2847-2848)
Mr. Gill (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 38 - 2.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
